acceptable_changes: Ten whole-sentence deletions with no rewording of surviving text.
Kept the first draft's light Niagara gloss, as the plan requires.

cut_evaluation.dependency_check: 'society has conspired to promote it' still leads directly into 'The moral is stentorian.' V1 and the 'vigor and economy' purpose remain.
cut_evaluation.reason: Removed the 'teacher is the worst criminal' sentence. It restates society's conspiracy to waste mind.

cut_evaluation.dependency_check: Paragraph 7's 'the easiest path led back to the east' still stands on its own. La Farge and the reluctance for a new education remain.
cut_evaluation.reason: Removed the trade-wind reverie sentence, which the plan marks as optional.

cut_evaluation.dependency_check: 'was a miracle' now leads into 'Wonder may be double--even treble.' The Niagara gloss and V4 remain.
cut_evaluation.reason: Removed the deck-stateroom/electric-light sentence as a second instance of the same wonder.

cut_evaluation.dependency_check: Kipling 'would have been first to feel what one meant' depends on the snub/patronize sentence. Henry James's mediation, V5 and King's wave-length joke remain.
cut_evaluation.reason: Rejected cutting the European snub sentence or the self-abasement sentence.

cut_evaluation.dependency_check: The paragraph now ends on 'political torpor.' Brice's Cleveland quip, its application to Harrison, the friends' mortality and 'King Banker' all remain.
cut_evaluation.reason: Removed the King/Hay party-loyalty sentence, a contrast the plan allows to be compressed.

cut_evaluation.dependency_check: King's resignation stays, since it sets up his later ambitious course in the West. Lamar's formula and the divorce argument remain intact.
cut_evaluation.reason: Removed Hay's resignation sentence because paragraph 8 already establishes Hay writing the Life of Lincoln.

cut_evaluation.dependency_check: 'they never needed him in equivalent office' still carries the essential point that Hay was used but never given office. 'always lost' remains.
cut_evaluation.reason: Removed the Hayes/Garfield/Harrison hypothetical, which elaborates a point already made.

cut_evaluation.dependency_check: Hay's liking to be used now leads straight to his laughing at himself for laughing.
cut_evaluation.reason: Removed the 'lapses of social convention' sentence, which anticipates the closing laugh.

cut_evaluation.dependency_check: It is the payoff of the Boutwell joke and supports the ten-thousand-a-year question.
The three readers are kept together. King's course remains 'still in doubt,' with no ruin narrated.
cut_evaluation.reason: Removed Hay's Lincoln-returns sentence, keeping Adams's own balance sheet.

cut_evaluation.dependency_check: 'They had lost the sense of worship' still follows naturally from 'no clearer idea than they.'
cut_evaluation.reason: Removed the Sinai wilderness simile, an ornamental lead-in.

cut_evaluation.dependency_check: The figure's assumed commonplace meaning, the observers and V6 remain. The occasion is still left unexplained.
cut_evaluation.reason: Removed the 'every detail interested him' sentence.

review_focus: The paragraph 10 transition from 'miracle' to 'Wonder may be double.'
The paragraph 14 jump from King's resignation to Adams holding no office.
The paragraph 19 opening on Adams's history.
risks: Paragraph 19's 'their chief title' now follows the three readers more closely, so the referent (Hay and Adams) is slightly looser.
The revised length is my estimate and has not been counted by code; it may land slightly under the 3300 target.
summary: Removed ten whole optional sentences from the first draft, an estimated net reduction of about 282 words. No bridges were added and no source material was restored. All surviving sentences are unchanged, and all eight protected excerpts remain verbatim.
